Method of Attack: Remote code execution via malicious ActiveX control embedded in Microsoft Office documents using MSHTML browser engine
Discoverer: Rick Cole of Microsoft Security Intelligence
Attack Vector: Malicious Microsoft Office document with embedded ActiveX control exploiting MSHTML engine
Indicators of Compromise: Suspicious Cpl File Execution alert in Microsoft Defender
Malicious .DOCX file loading remote web page via Internet Explorer engine
Use of ActiveX control to download malware
